sources.note: equipment plan source (research grade: datasheet); size 46 x 49 x 215 mm (w x d x h) (sources disagree on a dimension); port and control positions are placeholders until measured

Sennheiser MD 421-II product specification v1.1 (downloaded and read as text): "Connector XLR-3", "Dimensions 215 x 46 x 49 mm", weight about 385 g, five-position bass roll-off switch. SIZE IS AN ESTIMATE (plan sizeConfidence conflict: the sheet prints 46 x 49 mm and another page 48 x 48): a revolve needs a round footprint, so the widest of the sheet, 49 mm, is used for w and d; the 3 mm difference to the 46 mm axis is not modelled. Documents one XLR-3 output (gender not printed; male by convention).

build.profile: a 30 mm handle with a slim bass-switch waist, a flared neck and a 49 mm cylindrical head. No product photo was opened for this device, so the silhouette is a plausible lathe profile drawn from the published length and widest diameter, NOT measured from a photo or drawing: the size is exact, the shape between the stations is an estimate (confidence guess).

build.projection wrap: our own generic artwork (content/generic-panels/sennheiser-md-421-ii.json, drawn by npm run asset:panel): plain bands, rings and a stylised grille; no photo copy, no brand mark, no lettering. Colours: a typical finish for this kind of microphone, lifted for the creation lighting, not sampled from a photo unless a datasheet says the colour. A plain handle, a five-notch bass-switch ring and slotted head rings. out-xlr: on the base (bottom) face at its centre; no drawing gives it, so the confidence is guess.
